name: Forbidden Confessions: Neighbor
source:
The second entry of our Forbidden Confessions series, My Neighbor’s Daughter, entails the confession story of Mr. Jacobs, a lone wolf man in his mid-40s who has been living alone after his wife left him due to an affair. 

Mr. Jacobs was living peacefully for half a year and was about to move on when a new family moved in and became his neighbor.

He immediately got along with the Johnsons couple and secretly harbored feelings of lust towards Sandy - their daughter. This led to the occurrence of his best night ever.

[From [url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/forbidden-confessions-neighbor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《禁忌的告白》系列的第二部《邻居的女儿》讲述了雅各布斯先生的告白故事，他是一位40多岁的独狼男子，在妻子因外遇离开他后一直独自生活。

雅各布斯先生平静地生活了半年，正要搬家时，一个新家庭搬了进来，成为了他的邻居。

他立即与约翰逊夫妇相处融洽，并暗中对他们的女儿桑迪产生了情欲之情。这导致了他有史以来最美好的一个夜晚的发生。

[来自[url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/forbidden-confessions-neighbor]Itch.io[/url]]
